facts.fact: The document is the text of Tanzania's Access to Information Act, 2016 (Chapter 149), assented to on 23 September 2016, gazetted on 30 September 2016 and commenced on 1 July 2017 by the Access to Information (Date of Commencement) Notice, 2017; it gives every citizen a right to request information from public bodies and applies to Mainland Tanzania only.

systems.owner: Parliament of the United Republic of Tanzania; Minister responsible for legal affairs
systems.tiers: public authorities and certain private bodies, Mainland Tanzania

note: Media Services Act accreditation of content creators is a press law, class other; nothing on an access to information law.
EACJ case on an internet shutdown under the EAC Treaty and African Charter; names no access to information law and no decision under one.
TCRA licence suspension under online content regulations and the Electronic and Postal Communications Act; not an access to information law.

facts.fact: Civil society at an LHRC workshop discuss amending the Access to Information Act of 2016, whose section 5(1) gives every person the right to access information.

note: Reported non-response to a request and criticism of the law are not decisions or figures.
